title: Area-code shard C pass 25 — 686 / 689 / 701
summary: Bounded shard-C organization and public-person enumeration covering current U.S. geographic NPAs 686, 689, and 701.

data.research_question: Which current or historically relevant public organizations, public actors, and communication surfaces can be verified in the next unresolved shard-C U.S. geographic NPAs 686, 689, and 701?
data.method: Bounded deterministic shard-C area-code enumeration using current NANPA geographic membership, literal and locality-derived public web searches, first-party/current-status verification, repository dedupe, public-person role enumeration, and explicit uncertainty handling.
classification_rules: Historical directories are discovery seeds only; current-status verification is required before calling an organization active.
Do not infer individual political affiliation from organizational proximity, volunteering, attendance, residence, or public role.
Do not merge organizations or people from name or handle similarity alone.
Public person-org relations are directly stated unless qualifiers explicitly mark an inference.
For overlay NPAs, locality association does not imply a published phone number unless directly evidenced.

findings.notes: RVA Community Fridges is current through September 2026 with 17 fridges and Taylor Scott explicitly identified as founder. Richmond VA Food Not Bombs has current September 2026 activity, a weekly public distribution and a current anti-repression cooking project; S. Faye Alber is publicly listed as an Open Collective admin. NPA 686 overlays 804, so no 686 phone ownership is asserted.

The Really Really Free Market is an existing canonical org reused rather than duplicated; current September 2026 Linktree/event evidence adds 689 overlay locality context and Instagram/Facebook/Discord/email surfaces. S.W.A.M.P. Central Florida is a current/recent mutual-aid/disability-justice collective; X Sterling is directly reported as its launcher/founder. Historical Orlando Food Not Bombs references were not promoted without current verification.

Fargo-Moorhead Mutual Aid & Direct Action Network is corroborated by February and November 2025 public events; Olivia Fisher is directly identified as an organizer. Fargo Community Fridge is currently service-listed at 1402 1st Ave, but operator/governance identity remains unresolved. Historical directory seeds were not treated as current without verification.

data.narrative_role: bounded area-code organization and public-person enumeration pass
